captions.font_guess: heavy rounded sans (close to Arial Rounded MT Bold / Nunito Black)
captions.outline: #1C252A, ~3 px at 576 wide, plus soft shadow

look.grade: soft pastel daylight, gentle contrast, slightly desaturated sky (#A9CFE3 region), warm ground; dark desaturated grade for the ruins (S13-S14)
look.texture: painted paper/canvas grain on most surfaces and the sky; flat low-poly shading with soft shadows
look.motion_blur: camera-motion blur on fast moves (S1 swing, S6 dolly, S7 fly-over), rotor blur (S18)

shots.title: Street walk, the dog is pulled into the tornado
shots.camera: low camera on the sidewalk, man walks toward camera with the dog on a red leash; camera swings right (strong motion blur, ~frame 10-25) to a side view of the dog; ends wide on the man with the tornado in the background right, the dog flying into it
shots.subjects: lemec (walk cycle, then reaching), voxel dog (walk, then airborne), red leash, tornado (spinning rings + debris)
shots.set: suburban street: pastel townhouses (white, purple, yellow, blue, pink) with dark/red roofs, white picket fences, low-poly trees, sidewalk, road with white dashes, hills
shots.fx: camera motion blur on the swing; contact shadows; debris

shots.title: Dog spinning inside the tornado
shots.camera: close-up tracking the dog as it orbits in the tornado wall; dog drifts left→centre, mouth opens (barks)
shots.subjects: voxel dog (tan, black muzzle, white eyes with black pupils, red collar, red leash trailing), tornado wall texture (grey-green, paper blotches, horizontal bands), red/white debris chips

shots.title: 'That was theft.' + THEFT title
shots.camera: medium low-angle shot of the man facing camera, both hands raised in front (explaining gesture); static camera
shots.set: street with houses, trees, fence, road
shots.fx: title card drops from the top with motion blur and a bounce (frames 110-115), dark navy box, white bold text

shots.title: Phone call
shots.camera: selfie close-up, man holds a black phone to his ear with the right hand; eyes glance sideways, blink
shots.subjects: lemec close-up, black phone (handle text on screen — replaced by a neutral text in the replica)
shots.set: street perspective, houses, fence, tornado far behind

shots.title: Afterburner close-up
shots.camera: extreme close-up of an engine nozzle firing; petals dark with glowing orange inner edges
shots.subjects: jet nozzle + afterburner flame (white-yellow core, orange edge)

shots.title: Dolly along the jet
shots.camera: camera slides along the grey fuselage from the burning exhausts to the nose wheel
shots.subjects: fighter jet (grey, star-and-bar roundel, 'U.S. AIR FORCE' lettering), afterburners
shots.fx: fast camera move with motion blur

shots.title: Take-off and fly-over
shots.camera: wide runway shot, the jet takes off toward camera with dust, then passes over the camera (whip blur frames 240-242)

shots.title: Climb through clouds to the lock-on HUD
shots.camera: jet seen from behind climbing in blue sky (afterburners), camera passes through clouds (~f251-257), then looks down over the neighbourhood with the jet in the foreground and the tornado ahead; HUD corner brackets track the tornado, turn red, 'LOCKED' label
shots.subjects: fighter jet (rear), clouds, tornado (top-down), neighbourhood grid
shots.set: aerial neighbourhood: rows of small houses with red/blue/brown roofs, lawns, roads, trees
shots.fx: HUD overlay (white then red brackets, red LOCKED tag); cloud wipe

shots.title: 'It fired'
shots.camera: jet in profile in blue sky above clouds, missiles launch forward with flame and white trails

shots.title: Missile salvo on the tornado
shots.camera: aerial behind-the-jet view; dozens of white missile trails converge on the tornado; camera pushes toward it
shots.subjects: fighter jet (rear), missiles, tornado (top-down with rings)

shots.title: Hit
shots.camera: street level: the tornado behind the houses is hit, fireball and black smoke, debris flying
shots.set: street, houses (red, purple, yellow), white fence, road

shots.title: The neighbourhood is hit too
shots.camera: high wide view over rows of houses toward the tornado on the hills; explosions bloom among the houses

shots.title: 'All of it.'
shots.camera: dark wide shot: the whole neighbourhood in ruins, fires and black smoke columns, tornado in the background

shots.title: Surrender
shots.camera: street level on a burnt road: the tornado holds a white flag, burnt trees and fires behind
shots.subjects: tornado, white flag, burnt trees, fires

shots.title: Sentenced
shots.camera: courtroom: the tornado in the dock with giant handcuffs; judge small behind

shots.title: Judge and gavel
shots.camera: low angle on the judge (white wig, round glasses) striking the gavel
shots.set: judge's bench (navy panel with gold studs, name plate — replaced in the replica)

shots.title: 'Now it powers'
shots.camera: the tornado, still handcuffed, spins under a wind turbine; debris

shots.title: Turbine close-up
shots.camera: low angle on the turbine hub, blades spinning fast (motion blur), tornado top below

shots.title: Wide: officer and tornado
shots.camera: wide shot, tiny officer at the tornado's base, turbines

shots.title: Officer with a whip
shots.camera: officer cracks a whip at the tornado's base; rocks and debris

shots.title: 'it doesn't slow down'
shots.camera: wide: the tornado keeps spinning, rubble pile at the base

shots.title: R.I.P.
shots.camera: gravestone with the dog's framed portrait, flowers, fresh dirt mound; slow push-in; small tornadoes in the background
shots.subjects: gravestone ('R.I.P.', framed dog portrait, small engraved text — replaced in the replica), flowers, dirt mound, grass
